## Scope

State the exact spec symbols and work package implemented.

## Evidence

Report commands actually run, environment and results. Separate pure/model tests,
OS integration and real Desktop qualification. List all NOT RUN checks.

## Safety

Describe credential/network/process/write effects and rollback. State whether the
compatibility catalog remains empty and whether any mutation authority changes.
Never attach credentials, raw helper output, login URLs or real account details.

## Dependencies

List pins/lockfile changes and review status. Do not merge or release implicitly.
